subject: Expression of interest: early career civil engineering and drafting, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am lodging an expression of interest through your careers Tell Us About You pathway for early career civil engineering and drafting support roles.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so mentoring on civil design and documentation is what I am looking for.

Your early career programs put graduates in front of clients with real project responsibility, which is the kind of consulting start I want.

I have attached my resume and cover letter for the EOI form. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: I am submitting an expression of interest through your careers Tell Us About You pathway for early career civil engineering and drafting support. Your page invites undergraduates and graduates to share a CV for future roles across Australia.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines. I have also used Revit in coursework.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work and am open to discussing relocation for the right role. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment.
I have attached my resume for your talent community. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Thank you for considering this EOI.
